standard_prerequisites.name: Rlim M_n sits in the defining distinguished triangle Rlim M_n -> prod M_n -> prod M_n -> Rlim M_n[1]
standard_prerequisites.use: Fixes the triangle whose terms get identified after tensoring with K.

standard_prerequisites.name: Tensoring a pseudo-coherent complex K with a product of modules computes as the derived tensor with each factor: K tensor prod M_n = prod (K tensor^L M_n)
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the middle terms of the tensored triangle, forcing the cone to be K tensor Rlim M_n.

core_obligations: Start from the defining distinguished triangle Rlim M_n -> prod M_n -> prod M_n -> Rlim M_n[1] (proof lines 29853-29857). Tensor it with K; by the pseudo-coherent tensor lemma the product terms become prod (K tensor^L M_n) (proof lines 29857-29858). The cone of prod (K tensor^L M_n) -> prod (K tensor^L M_n) is by definition Rlim (K tensor^L M_n), so the triangle identifies K tensor^L Rlim M_n = Rlim (K tensor^L M_n), which is the assertion (proof lines 29853-29858).
proof_roadmap: Write the defining triangle of Rlim M_n (proof lines 29853-29857).
Tensor with K and use the pseudo-coherent tensor lemma to identify the product terms and read off the equality (proof lines 29857-29858).
